scope: Separate technical license review of the Next.js 16.4.2 host dependency delta. The Office 0.3.4 archive and its strict license policy are unchanged.

limits: This is a host dependency delta review, not a claim that host dependencies satisfy the Office-only permissive allowlist.
Existing host libvips/Sharp LGPL, caniuse-lite CC-BY and bundled component obligations remain applicable.
The libvips upstream notice list changes cairo from MPL 2.0 to MPL 1.1, highway to BSD 3-Clause, removes libspng and adds libultrahdr; source notice texts were retained for review.
Registry identity/SRI, SPDX declarations and available notice files were checked; this does not certify legal compliance of every deployment or redistribution.
